Heights of faba bean plants in a field trial

Source: R/data.R
FabaHeights26.Rd

Repeated height measurements of 320 faba bean plants in a field trial (2026): five plants in each of 64 plots, with four genotypes on two soil types, irrigated or not, measured on 14 days between 28 and 122 days after sowing. The Loamy plots were not measured 77 days after sowing, and five single measurements are missing, so the data have 4315 rows instead of 4480.

Usage

FabaHeights26

Format

A data frame with 4315 rows and 7 variables:

DAS

days after sowing

Genotype

genotype: Lynx, Melodie, Navarra or Stella

Plot_ID

identifier of the plot, 1-64

Plant_ID

identifier of the plant, a factor unique to each plant: plot and plant number within the plot, e.g. "31_5"

Soil

soil type: Loamy or Sandy

Treatment

Irrigated or NotIrrigated

Height

plant height in cm

The raw data and the script that converts them are in the directory data-raw of the source package.

Examples

fit <- gcTMB(Height ~ DAS, fform=b1 ~ Soil * Treatment, data=FabaHeights26)
summary(fit)
